assessment: This study describes a comprehensive set of classical techniques in biochemistry and cell biology characterizing the unconventional secretory mechanism of α-synuclein, an important contributor to neurodegeneration. The major finding is that palmitoylated DNAJC5 oligomers play a central role in this unusual secretory pathway, presumably by mediating entry of α-synuclein into late endosomes. Future work will clarify the mechanisms by which this cargo is exported from the cell.
